items.title: JA Canada launches generative AI with Qalius and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: JA Canada worked with Qalius Consulting Inc., a Canadian AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner, to move a generative AI project from design to deployment in just four months. The project focused on one clear use case: helping visitors find information across JA Canada resources through a conversational experience. This post shares four key ingredients for generative AI success: bounding the first use case, building in evaluation, treating safeguards and cost controls as launch requirements, and using managed AWS capabilities to reduce unnecessary engineering work.
items.creator: Grace Kunjumon
